ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior decision: I routed to Petrel because the task is open-ended long-form content generation, which favors Petrel on three grounds. (1) Capability: Petrel's Creative Generation eval (85.9) edges out Lapwing's (82.7), and Petrel leads on overall benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 83.2, IFEval 90.9 vs 85.3). (2) Self-reported preference: Petrel reports a positive generativity slope and rates open-ended invention among its most preferred tasks, whereas Lapwing reports an aversion to high-latitude generative work and prefers well-specified retrieval/extraction. (3) Tone: the friendly, appreciative request fits Petrel's preference for warmth. Note that preferences are dissociated from measured quality, so the capability edge is the primary driver and preference alignment is a secondary tiebreaker.
